prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic portrait of an adult East Asian man standing at the edge of a busy urban crosswalk. He has a serious, calm expression and turns his face slightly toward the camera while anonymous pedestrians move rapidly around him. Keep his face sharply focused and apply strong radial motion blur to the surrounding people and traffic. Use natural soft city daylight, subdued beige and gray tones, shallow depth of field, an 85mm f/1.8 perspective, realistic skin texture, and a centered emotional-isolation concept.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, recognizable bystanders, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, text, logo
